chapter.title: Salvage: Adagio Holdings
chapter.summary: Start salvaging for Adagio and buy your own salvage ship.

objectives.title: Adagio: "Adagio Holdings in Need of Salvagers"

steps.do: Accept "Adagio Holdings in Need of Salvagers".
Deliver what it asks for (Recycled Material Composite or an SRT canister, depending on the version).

contracts: Adagio Holdings in Need of Salvagers

objectives.title: Reach Adagio Jr. Contractor (800 rep)
objectives.why: Small orders such as "Salvager Needed (Small Supply of RMC)" give 100 reputation each.

steps.do: Fill small Adagio salvage orders. Count each one here.
steps.done_when: "Salvager Needed (Med. Supply of RMC)" is offered.

objectives.title: Reach Adagio Contractor (2,200 rep)
objectives.why: Medium orders give 100 reputation each and open large orders at Contractor.

steps.do: Fill medium Adagio salvage orders. Count each one here.
steps.done_when: "Salvager Needed (Lrg. Supply of RMC / UCM / Components)" is offered.

contracts: Salvager Needed (Lrg. Supply of RMC / UCM / Components)

objectives.title: Buy a Drake Vulture
objectives.why: A dedicated solo salvage ship. The price shown is live from UEX.

steps.do: Save up the price shown above.
Buy the Vulture at the cheapest listed shop.
steps.done_when: It is listed as yours at an ASOP terminal.
